prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 34.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Orientation Screen: Introduce a dedicated new screen 'new_desktop_controls_guide' right before completing onboarding to visually explain hotkeys and system tray controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, while finish step conversion drops to 73.8%.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Account Creation to Final Companion Handoff: Move the sign_in screen to occur after the waiting step immediately before home_intro so users experience setup first. (why: Early sign-in causes friction, while 8 support tickets mention pets missing/reset after signing in with wrong accounts early on.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Activity Log on Waiting Screen: Add a real-time activity log component to the waiting screen showing asset rendering and behavior initialization progress. (why: Home step (waiting) has a mean time of 2336s (38+ minutes), leading to drop-offs when users assume the app has hung.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Overlay Launch Reassurance Copy: Update home_intro headline and body to reassure users that the pet will render over all desktop apps safely without stealing window focus. (why: 3 support emails reported issues with pets not displaying or opening on desktop, and finish step drops 26.2%.)
4: [home, notification] Asset Preparation Completion Desktop Alert Prompt: Enable background notification switch and opt-in message during the waiting step so users get alerted when generation finishes. (why: Waiting time mean is extremely long (2336s), causing users to switch away and forget the desktop app.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Centered Visual Highlights Layout: Re-layout the story screen to centered with visual mascot animation and step countdown counter to set quick expectations. (why: Mean time on initial screens is high (514s), requiring a cleaner, faster intro layout.)
